evidence.locator: The independently encoded7x7 indexed8 collision has ctFlags32768 and ColorSpec values7,0,3. Ordinary raster index0 is red255,0,0; the raw sampler chooses gray RGB16(8481,8481,8481), mapped once to current-display48,48,48. For the exact repeat push case, (4,0) and(0,4) are gray while ordinary corner(0,0) remains red. For the unchanged ordinary11x16 c3/s1 repeat header, sampled top line x3..7/y0 and left line x0/y3..12 use gray48; the solid union is x3..7/y1..14 plus x1..9/y3..12, all remaining pixels transparent. The full176-pixel literal and actual owned companion joins establish only this current-display sampled-color case.
